lines.text: Nobelpreis fürs Licht im Hirn. Im Treppenhaus bleibt's dunkel.
lines.meaning: Topical: on 5 October the Medicine Nobel Prize went to Peter Hegemann (Berlin) and Georg Nagel (Würzburg) with Karl Deisseroth, for optogenetics, light-controlled cells (nobelprize.org, ZDF heute, 5 Oct 2026). Shows 11 to 16 October in Germany, on about one day in three.

lines.text: The new banknotes get a puffin and a hedgehog. Dignified.
